scenes.title: 29-2-12, Monte Carlo, Kid Mac Koy - Carpentier [boxeurs]
scenes.description: A press photograph by Agence Rol, dated 29 February 1912, showing the boxers Kid Mac Koy and Carpentier in Monte Carlo.
scenes.explanation: Foam-soled slide sandals did not exist in 1912, when footwear was leather boots and laced shoes.

scenes.title: Sanctuary of Aphrodite
scenes.description: The photograph shows the Sanctuary of Aphrodite at Afaia Skaramagka, a site dedicated to the ancient goddess Aphrodite, with its visible remains, especially the hollows in the rock. It was taken in 2006 by Chaïdári, and the site is identified with the Sanctuary of Aphrodite mentioned by Pausanias on the road to Eleusis, though more about the type of worship there is unknown.
scenes.explanation: A compact self-balancing humanoid robot of this kind does not exist in 2026, so it cannot appear in a photograph taken in 2006.

source.description: Το Ιερό της Αφροδίτης στην Αφαία Σκαραμαγκά είναι ένας χώρος αφιερωμένος στην αρχαία θεά Αφροδίτη. Αυτός ο χώρος ταυτίζεται με το Ιερό της Αφροδίτης, το οποίο αναφέρεται από τον Παυσανία καθ' οδόν προς την Ελευσίνα, χωρίς όμως να γνωρίζουμε περισσότερα για το είδος της λατρείας που λάμβανε χώρα. Tα ορατά λείψανα, κυρίως δε οι εσοχές στο βράχο τράβηξαν την προσοχή των ξένων περιηγητών από την αρχή του 19ου αιώνα.

scenes.title: The Atlantique at the quay in Cherbourg
scenes.description: A press photograph by Agence Mondial showing the Atlantique docked at a quay in Cherbourg, dated 1933. The glass negative is held by the Bibliothèque nationale de France, département Estampes et photographie.
scenes.anomaly: modern LED work light on a tripod
scenes.explanation: High-output LED work lights on folding tripods did not exist in 1933; portable electric floodlights of that era used incandescent bulbs and were far bulkier.

scenes.title: Gate
scenes.description: A photograph from the National Library of Norway, dated 1954 and in the public domain, showing a gate. No photographer, location, or other details are stated in the record.
scenes.explanation: LED traffic signal heads did not exist in 1954, when signals used incandescent lamps in simple round housings.
scenes.credit: Henriksen & Steen via National Library of Norway

scenes.title: Part of the building
scenes.description: A view of part of a building, with the Roode Steen visible. The photograph was taken in 1930 and is held by Europeana under a CC BY-SA licence.
scenes.explanation: Electronic load-cell platform scales with digital readouts did not exist in 1930, when produce was weighed on mechanical steelyard or balance scales.
